capabilities: renders Mapbox vector map styles and tiles
resolves search terms to place suggestions and coordinates
builds directions between waypoints in a block
snaps recorded tracks to roads and paths
disambiguation: Not a standalone map plugin; it only provides Mapbox map data and services to the Places plugin.
extras: README only lists network requests and dependencies; it points to a sandbox for examples and gives no usage instructions.
intentEvidence: This is not a stand-alone plugin, to use, install along side Places.
problem: The Places plugin needs an outside map service to draw maps and to resolve searches, routes, elevation and track alignment.

relations.evidence: This is not a stand-alone plugin, to use, install along side Places.

summary: Map provider that supplies Mapbox vector maps, POI search, directions, isochrones, elevation and 3D terrain to the Places plugin.
